name: Minecraft Bedrock
author: aetheris-project
description: Official Minecraft Bedrock Edition dedicated server for Linux, with automatic latest-version resolution and EULA acceptance.

installation.script:
# @author Aetheris Project
# @description Minecraft Bedrock install script
# @user-alpine

apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y curl unzip jq

BEDROCK_URL=$(curl -s https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/download/server/bedrock | grep -oP 'https://[^"]+bedrock-server-[^"]+\.zip' | head -1)
if [ -z "${BEDROCK_URL}" ]; then
  echo "Could not resolve the Bedrock server download URL." >&2
  exit 1
fi
curl -s -o bedrock.zip "${BEDROCK_URL}"
unzip -o bedrock.zip -d .
rm -f bedrock.zip

if [ "${ACCEPT_EULA}" == "1" ]; then
  echo "eula=true" > eula.txt
else
  echo "eula=false" > eula.txt
fi

if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
  cat > server.properties <<EOF
server-port=${SERVER_PORT:-19132}
motd=${MOTD:-Aetheris Bedrock Server}
max-players=${MAX_PLAYERS:-20}
gamemode=${GAMEMODE:-survival}
difficulty=${DIFFICULTY:-easy}
EOF
fi

variables.name: Server Port
variables.description: UDP port the server listens on.

variables.name: MOTD
variables.description: Server description shown in the server list.
